notes.title: 2025/6/13 Update Patch
notes.notes:
2025/6/13 Update Patch

Fixed lag issues on certain device models

Fixed an issue where after a room disbanded during combat, players would attempt to re-enter the room when exiting matchmade battles

New users will now have their language automatically selected based on region during first login

Fixed an issue where random terrain generation on the Rooftop map could occasionally trap players

Fixed UI freeze when accepting friend invitations while on the main menu or character selection screen

Fixed an issue where some small animals' eyes wouldn't display on medium graphics settings

Optimized some physics calculations to improve performance

Fixed an issue where cookies could sometimes be knocked out of visible bounds on the Cookie map

notes.title: Epic Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow Guru Gurus!

During the ongoing New Product Festival, Guru Guru has received an epic major update!

Game Improvements:

All scene assets have been updated—a brand-new Guru Guru world awaits you!

More playable Guru Gurus have been added, and existing ones have received adorable new looks. Try them all!

Refreshed UI assets make the entire game feel brand new.

A revamped tutorial ensures even first-time players can easily become a proper Guru Guru.

A dynamic terrain system ensures that the same map offers a fresh experience every time.

Enhanced physics for more realism and greater challenges.

Bug Fixes:

Improved online connectivity—no more worries about finding teammates!

Better controller support for smoother gameplay.

Fixed AI combat behavior in certain situations.

Fixed texture tearing issues for some characters.

Addressed bugs from the previous demo.
